title: ClojureScript Gets Async/Await
summary: ClojureScript releases support for async/await syntax, bringing the popular JavaScript asynchronous programming pattern to the functional Clojure ecosystem. This allows developers to write more readable async code while maintaining compatibility with existing ClojureScript codebases.
problem_solved: Provides a more familiar imperative-style async pattern for developers while maintaining Clojure's functional paradigm and interop with JavaScript promises.
why_valuable: Bridges the gap between Clojure's traditional channel-based async (core.async) and mainstream async/await patterns, making ClojureScript more accessible to a broader developer community while simplifying promise-based interop.
